title: GATE started by Sidney Marland in 1972, possibly as a funnel

tellings.quote: I think the gate program was started by Sydney Marland in 1972

plain: GATE, a US school program for gifted and talented children, was started in 1972 by an official named Sidney Marland, according to Michels, who says so himself in an episode about a guest who says he was taken into a UFO program as a child. Michels floats the idea that the program may have served as a funnel, picking out unusual children for secret government work, and he brings in the senator Frank Church alongside it; if true, a school program would have been a recruiting channel.
